sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Scav body is a Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Corpse of a deceased Scav. A 5x5 loot container that only spawns the RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Green).

sections.heading: Ground Zero
sections.text: Leaned against the yellow bus at the "Mira Ave" extraction.
